title: Choose a select option
summary: Selenium's Select helper handles a native select element. Choose an option by its stored value.
introduction: Selenium's Select helper handles a native select element. Choose an option by its stored value. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Selenium's Select helper handles a native select element. Choose an option by its stored value.

blocks.code:
from urllib.parse import quote
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
try:
    driver.get("data:text/html;charset=utf-8," + quote('<select id="size"><option value="s">Small</option><option value="l">Large</option></select>'))
    from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import Select
    menu = Select(driver.find_element(By.ID, "size"))
    menu.select_by_value("l")
    assert menu.first_selected_option.text == "Large"
finally:
    driver.quit()
